entry_fields.source: upstream URL or registry reference without credentials
entry_fields.image_digest: digest or image-store identity, interpreted only with digest_kind
entry_fields.image_id: exact Docker image-store identity when applicable
entry_fields.image_config_digest: independently verified config digest, otherwise null
entry_fields.registry_manifest_digest: independently verified published registry digest, otherwise null
entry_fields.owner_resource_id: workspace/trial ID for private runtime records
entry_fields.retention_until: retention policy timestamp or pinned reason
